title: Require Generic Service Anchor Exports
forbids: an existing service spine or module composition router without the direct generic const export for its role, while excluding named operation leaves and the required embedded API-plugin boundary/type base.ts from generic base/router anchor naming
why: Direct base, contract, service, module, and router anchors give exact authoring and composition one stable structural name while callers provide product qualification.
remediate: Directly export base from standalone base.ts; service from root impl.ts; contract from contract.ts; module from module.ts; and router from each root or module router.ts. Give named router/*.router.ts leaves and subrouters domain names, then compose them in module/router.ts. Keep embedded API-plugin base.ts as its required boundary/type anchor without a runtime base export.
message: Each service spine file must directly export its generic local anchor.
